validation_scope: Independent code and equation review followed by executable integrity checks

findings_and_repairs: Ordinary feedback calculations now reuse saved prediction tensors instead of resampling encoder dropout.
Original source-row indices persist through event ingestion, canonical serialization, and bundle update sorting.
Effective-batch objectives are centered and normalized over the complete valid-event set.
Fractional entropy exponents use a finite derivative at the zero suppression-factor boundary.
Attention matrix operations run in an explicit FP32 autocast-disabled region.
Sequence input validation precedes runtime-state mutation.
Initialization-only segments do not occupy optimizer batches or warm-up step counts.
Partition metadata requires explicit lists; chronology and raw-row tie ordering are validated.
Validation and independent checkpoint assessment inherit the stored backbone precision.
Runtime protocol metadata prevents reopening solving groups, response replay, and backward chronology across calls.
Native EdNet and ASSIST event-integrity checks are included in the distributable test suite.
The CUDA wheel switch specifies its build explicitly; supported Python versions and actual execution scope are stated.
Source wording and the complete README command inventory were audited.

benchmark_status: Full public-dataset AUC and GPU cost measurements are not included in the software checks.
input_constraint: Complete XES3G5M event exports require unique event IDs; public sequence fragments do not reliably retain them.
